title: One contact's call is booked, another's time only proposed: each file keeps its own state

objects.subject: Arjun <> Farhan Ali (Bluewater Studio)
objects.body:
Arjun, meet Farhan Ali, who runs Bluewater Studio, a design agency of twenty. Farhan, meet Arjun Rao, the founder of Nimbus Labs, who is building an AI chief of staff for founders. I'll let you two take it from here.

Introly

objects.subject: Arjun <> Ira Menon (Lanternfish)
objects.body:
Arjun, meet Ira Menon, a product lead at Lanternfish. Ira, meet Arjun Rao, the founder of Nimbus Labs, who is building an AI chief of staff for founders. I'll let you two take it from here.

Introly

objects.subject: Re: Arjun <> Farhan Ali (Bluewater Studio)
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

Great to meet you. I've sent you an invite for Thursday 14 August at 4 pm IST to see the product. Looking forward to it.

Farhan Ali
Founder, Bluewater Studio

objects.summary: Nimbus Labs demo — Farhan Ali (Bluewater Studio)

objects.subject: Re: Arjun <> Ira Menon (Lanternfish)
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

Thanks for the intro. Would Tuesday 12 August at 11 am work for a call? If not, send me a time that suits you.

Best,
Ira Menon
Product Lead, Lanternfish

notes: Replay 02 m03: Farhan's demo is on both calendars for Thursday; Ira has only proposed Tuesday. Ira's card answers her proposed time; Farhan's file waits for its call with nothing to do — and no card carries the other contact's time.
